name: Amines & Plasticizers Ltd
description: AboutIncorporated in 1973, Amines & Plasticizers Ltd manufactures over 60 different varieties of organic chemicals, amines, solvents, andfertilizers.[1]Key PointsBusiness Overview:[1]APL was initially formed to take over India Carbons Ltd.’s project for manufacturing 3,000 tonnes of DOP plasticizers used in PVC applications. Over time, it evolved into a manufacturer and trader of organic and inorganic chemicals, including ethanolamines, morpholine, plasticizers, alkyl morpholine, gas treating solvents (like methyl diethanolamine), and morpholine oxide. Today, APL is a global supplier serving a wide range of industries.Read MoreWebsiteBSENSE
